name: Capacitor Voltage
definition: The electric potential difference across the capacitor plates, measured in Volts (V).

name: Supply Voltage
definition: The constant voltage provided by the power source (battery or power supply), measured in Volts (V).

name: Voltage Difference
definition: The difference between Supply Voltage and Capacitor Voltage, which drives current flow through the resistor.

name: Current
definition: The flow of electric charge through the circuit, measured in Amperes (A).

name: Charging Rate
definition: The rate at which charge accumulates on the capacitor plates, equal to the current (dQ/dt = I).

name: Capacitor Charge
definition: The total electric charge stored on the capacitor plates, measured in Coulombs (C).

name: Resistance
definition: The opposition to current flow provided by the resistor, measured in Ohms (Ω).
